name: Meniscus
description: MEN.2a STUB — a serpentine line-strip water surface drawn in low-oblique perspective: one continuous polyline snaking across a wave-propagation height field, brightness taken from local slope so crests read near-white and troughs near-black, floating over a grainy dark ground plane lit by a single cool key light. The sideways glow spread is built into the line geometry as screen-X extruded quads under MAX blending, which keeps the raster open in Y. NO AUDIO COUPLING YET: the surface runs on a placeholder procedural swell. The source's own drop placement lands at MEN.2b (the faithful base); per-stem impact regions at MEN.3.
author: Matt
